## Supplementary Data Captions

| **Captions for Supplementary Data.** Original data are included in spreadsheets S1 to S7 of this Excel file. In all cases, variable codes are as in 'KEY to variables'. |
| --- |
|  |
| **Data S1.** Codes, location and altitude for all 76 study sites (38 landscapes x 2 sites) where the dung beetle surveys and field experiments on dung removal took place. |
| **Data S2.** Climatic variables used in the analyses, referred to all 76 study sites. |
| **Data S3.** Results of all replicates of the dung beetle removal experiments. |
| **Data S4.** Results of the dung beetle surveys. Numbers indicate the individuals of each species captured by each pitfall trap. |
| **Data S5.** Summary of trait values for all dung beetle species measured, based on the raw data from S6. |
| **Data S6.** Trait measurements for all dung beetle individuals measured in the study. |
| **Data S7.** Diversity metrics measured in all 76 study sites. |

## KEY to variables

| Data # | Sheet | Variable | Long name |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | SITES | Site Code | Code to identify each site. Composed by the first 3 letters of the country, a sequential number to differentiate between sites in the same country (if more than one in the same country) and 3 letters identifying the treatment (Intensive or Extensive) |
| S1 | SITES | Site | Same as Site code but without the 3 letters identifying the treatment |
| S1 | SITES | Treatment | The treatment of the site. There is no absolute threshold to define one or other treatment. It is a categorical variable describing the treatments within each site. |
| S1 | SITES | Cattle Density | number of cows per hectare |
| S1 | SITES | Land Use | Number of years the grassland was used for cattle grazing |
| S1 | SITES | Antihelmintic | number of antihelmintic doses per year given to the cattle |
| S1 | SITES | Date | Survey date |
| S1 | SITES | Bioregion | Bioregion |
| S1 | SITES | Continent | Continent |
| S1 | SITES | Country | Country |
| S1 | SITES | Locality | Locality |
| S1 | SITES | Latitude | WGS84 coordinates |
| S1 | SITES | Longitude | WGS84 coordinates |
| S1 | SITES | Altitude | meters above sea level |
| S2 | CLIMATE | Mean Temp Year | reported by fieldwork teams. Mean annual temperature ₍Cº) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | Mean Temp Month | reported by fieldwork teams. Mean temperature of the month in which the survey was done (Cº) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | Mean Prec Year | reported by fieldwork teams. Mean annual precipitation (mm) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | Mean Prec Month | reported by fieldwork teams. Mean precipitation of the month in which the survey was done ₍mm) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | Mean Humid Year | reported by fieldwork teams. Mean annual humidity (%) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | Mean Humid Month | reported by fieldwork teams. Mean humidity of the month in which the survey was done (%) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.1 | Annual Mean Temperature |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.2 | Mean Diurnal Range (Mean of monthly (max temp - min temp)) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.3 | Isothermality (BIO2/BIO7) (×100) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.4 | Temperature Seasonality (standard deviation ×100) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.5 | Max Temperature of Warmest Month |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.6 | Min Temperature of Coldest Month |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.7 | Temperature Annual Range (BIO5-BIO6) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.8 | Mean Temperature of Wettest Quarter |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.9 | Mean Temperature of Driest Quarter |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.10 | Mean Temperature of Warmest Quarter |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.11 | Mean Temperature of Coldest Quarter |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.12 | Annual Precipitation |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.13 | Precipitation of Wettest Month |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.14 | Precipitation of Driest Month |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.15 | Precipitation Seasonality (Coefficient of Variation) |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.16 | Precipitation of Wettest Quarter |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.17 | Precipitation of Driest Quarter |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.18 | Precipitation of Warmest Quarter |
| S2 | CLIMATE | BIO.19 | Precipitation of Coldest Quarter |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Unit type | Experimental unit (freely accessible to beetles) or Control (dung pad coverd by a net preventing beetle activity) |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Sampling Unit | Sequential number to identify each sampling unit |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Initial dung wet | grams |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Final dung wet | grams |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Final dung dry | grams. After 72h in a 60ºC oven |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Control dung dry | grams. After 72h in a 60ºC oven |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Paper bag | grams |
| S3 | REMOVAL | Paper bag dry | grams. After 72h in a 60ºC oven |
| S4 | TRAPS | Trap number | sequential number to identify each trap |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | Dung relocation strategy | The behaviour of the species when processing dung for feeding or reproducing |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | Subfamily | Subfamily |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | Species | Latin name of the species |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | Specimen number | Sequential number to identify each specimen within the same species |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | Trait | Trait name. See below full name and unit of each trait |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | Measurement | Value for the measured trait |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | HL | Head length (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | HW | Head width (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | PL | Pronotum length (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | PW | Pronotum width (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | PH | Pronotum height (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | EL | Elytra length (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | pTL | Protibia length (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | pTW | Protibia width (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | mTL | Metatiba length (mm) |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | Biomass | Dry weight (grams) of whole individual after 72h in a 60ºC oven |
| S5, S6 | TRAITS | reloc.size | A behavioural trait resembling that of Doube 1990 which combines “Dung relocation strategy” and “body size”. Thus, 9 categories of coprophages + 1 kleptocoprid |
| S7 | DIVERSITY | Abundance | Number of individuals |
| S7 | DIVERSITY | Richness | Number of species |

| S7 | DIVERSITY | MPD behav | MPD for behavioural traits |

| S7 | DIVERSITY | RaoQ behav | RaoQ for behavioural traits |
| S7 | DIVERSITY | Fric morph | Functional richness for morphological traits |
